verses.text: Therefore, let us fear if, while a promise remains of entering His rest, any one of you may seem to have come short of it.
verses.textZh: 我們既蒙留下，有進入他安息的應許，就當畏懼，免得我們（原文是你們）中間或有人似乎是趕不上了。

verses.text: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, just as they also; but the word they heard did not profit them, because it was not united by faith in those who heard.
verses.textZh: 因為有福音傳給我們，像傳給他們一樣；只是所聽見的道與他們無益，因為他們沒有信心與所聽見的道調和。

verses.text: For we who have believed enter that rest, just as He has said, 'AS I SWORE IN MY WRATH, THEY SHALL NOT ENTER MY REST,' although His works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.textZh: 但我們已經相信的人得以進入那安息，正如神所說：我在怒中起誓說：他們斷不可進入我的安息！其實造物之工，從創世以來已經成全了。

verses.text: For He has said somewhere concerning the seventh [day]: 'AND GOD RESTED ON THE SEVENTH DAY FROM ALL HIS WORKS';
verses.textZh: 論到第七日，有一處說，到第七日神就歇了他一切的工。

verses.text: and again in this [passage], 'THEY SHALL NOT ENTER MY REST.'
verses.textZh: 又有一處說：他們斷不可進入我的安息！

verses.text: Therefore, since it remains for some to enter it, and those who formerly had good news preached to them failed to enter because of disobedience,
verses.textZh: 既有必進安息的人，那先前聽見福音的，因為不信從，不得進去。

verses.text: He again fixes a certain day, 'Today,' saying through David after so long a time just as has been said before, 'TODAY IF YOU HEAR HIS VOICE, DO NOT HARDEN YOUR HEARTS.'
verses.textZh: 所以過了多年，就在大衛的書上，又限定一日，如以上所引的說：你們今日若聽他的話，就不可硬著心。

verses.text: For if Joshua had given them rest, He would not have spoken of another day after that.
verses.textZh: 若是約書亞已叫他們享了安息，後來神就不再提別的日子了。

verses.text: So there remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
verses.textZh: 這樣看來，必另有一安息日的安息為神的子民存留。

verses.text: For the one who has entered His rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from His.
verses.textZh: 因為那進入安息的，乃是歇了自己的工，正如神歇了他的工一樣。

verses.text: Therefore let us be diligent to enter that rest, so that no one will fall, through [following] the same example of disobedience.
verses.textZh: 所以，我們務必竭力進入那安息，免得有人學那不信從的樣子跌倒了。

verses.text: For the word of God is living and active and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing as far as the division of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and able to judge the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verses.textZh: 神的道是活潑的，是有功效的，比一切兩刃的劍更快，甚至魂與靈，骨節與骨髓，都能刺入、剖開，連心中的思念和主意都能辨明。

verses.text: And there is no creature hidden from His sight, but all things are open and laid bare to the eyes of Him with whom we have to do.
verses.textZh: 並且被造的沒有一樣在他面前不顯然的；原來萬物在那與我們有關係的主眼前，都是赤露敞開的。

verses.text: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.
verses.textZh: 我們既然有一位已經升入高天尊榮的大祭司，就是神的兒子耶穌，便當持定所承認的道。

verses.text: For we do not have a high priest who cannot sympathize with our weaknesses, but One who has been tempted in all things as [we are, yet] without sin.
verses.textZh: 因我們的大祭司並非不能體恤我們的軟弱。他也曾凡事受過試探，與我們一樣，只是他沒有犯罪。

verses.text: Therefore let us draw near with confidence to the throne of grace, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.textZh: 所以，我們只管坦然無懼的來到施恩的寶座前，為要得憐恤，蒙恩惠，作隨時的幫助。
